title: Mobile IV Hydration for Busy Schedules
summary: Mobile IV hydration brings convenient, nurse-led wellness services to your home, office, or hotel in Sarasota and Bradenton. No extra trip required.

children.text: Key takeaways
Mobile IV hydration brings professional hydration services directly to your home, office, hotel, or vacation rental.
Busy professionals, parents, healthcare workers, and travelers can schedule appointments around their existing routines.
IV hydration delivers fluids and electrolytes directly into the bloodstream when medically appropriate.
Avida Luna Wellness provides personalized, nurse-led mobile IV hydration throughout Sarasota and Bradenton.
How can you make time for wellness when your schedule is already full?
Between work deadlines, school pickups, meetings, appointments, and everything else on your calendar, finding time to take care of yourself can feel like another task on an endless to-do list.

You know hydration matters. You know getting enough rest, eating well, and prioritizing your health are important. The challenge isn't always knowing what to do. Sometimes, it's finding the time to actually do it.
For busy professionals, parents, business owners, and anyone balancing a demanding schedule, even a wellness appointment can feel inconvenient.
Taking care of yourself shouldn't require rearranging your whole schedule.

That's where mobile IV hydration comes in. Instead of driving to a clinic, waiting for your appointment, and traveling back, a qualified healthcare professional brings hydration services directly to you.
What is mobile IV hydration?
Mobile IV hydration delivers intravenous fluids and electrolytes directly to you, rather than requiring you to visit a traditional clinic.

IV therapy administers fluids through a small catheter placed in a vein. Depending on your individual needs and medical eligibility, certain formulations may also contain vitamins or other ingredients.
With Avida Luna Wellness, Shary, an experienced registered nurse, travels to your location with the necessary supplies and equipment.

Before your infusion, you'll complete a medical assessment with Shary and a required telehealth consultation with a healthcare provider. This process is completed once every six months and can be done on the spot during your first appointment or in advance, so you're ready when it's time for your infusion.
Once you're cleared, Shary prepares your infusion, gets you comfortably settled, and monitors you throughout your appointment.
It's professional, personalized nursing care delivered wherever it's most convenient for you.
How does mobile IV hydration fit into your daily routine?
One of the biggest advantages of mobile IV hydration is flexibility. You don't have to build your entire day around an appointment when the appointment can come to you.
For business owners and busy professionals

Running a business or managing a demanding career often means your calendar fills up before the week even begins. Between client calls, meetings, and daily responsibilities, stepping away for a wellness appointment isn't always practical.
Shary has provided mobile IV hydration in corporate offices, including appointments where clients continued working at their desks or participated in Zoom meetings during their infusions.
Depending on your IV and work environment, you may be able to answer emails, handle administrative tasks, or simply take a break while receiving your infusion.
For parents managing everyone's schedule
School drop-offs, extracurricular activities, grocery shopping, and family responsibilities can make finding a quiet moment for yourself challenging.
Parents often spend so much time organizing everyone else's schedules that their own needs end up at the bottom of the list.
With mobile IV hydration, you can schedule an appointment at home without arranging another trip across town. It's one less logistical hurdle between you and making time for yourself.
For healthcare workers and professionals with demanding hours
If you work long shifts, unpredictable hours, or physically demanding jobs, you know how valuable your time away from work can be.
Healthcare workers, first responders, hospitality professionals, and others with demanding schedules don't always have the luxury of a traditional nine-to-five routine.
Mobile IV hydration allows you to schedule services around your availability, whether that's on a day off or during a convenient window between responsibilities.
For frequent travelers
Travel can be exciting, but it can also disrupt your usual routines. Between flights, changing schedules, sightseeing, and Florida's warm weather, it's easy to overlook everyday hydration habits.
Avida Luna Wellness brings mobile IV hydration to hotels, vacation rentals, and Airbnbs throughout its service area.
Whether you're visiting Sarasota for business or spending a weekend in Bradenton, you can inquire about hydration services without leaving your accommodations.
Why is staying hydrated important when you're busy?
Water plays an essential role in nearly every system in your body, from regulating temperature and supporting circulation to transporting nutrients and maintaining normal function.
Even mild dehydration can contribute to headaches, fatigue, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating.
Between demanding schedules, nutritional gaps, caffeine consumption, and the constant demands of everyday life, it's easy to fall behind on hydration and the nutrients your body needs.
Drinking more water isn't always the whole answer.

Your body also relies on electrolytes like sodium, potassium, and magnesium to maintain fluid balance, support muscle function, and keep your nervous system working properly. When you're losing fluids through sweat or other activities, you're losing electrolytes along with them.
While drinking water is essential, it doesn't replace all the vitamins and minerals your body needs. Proper hydration also involves balanced nutrition and replenishing electrolytes when necessary.

Mobile IV hydration offers an additional option for delivering fluids and electrolytes directly into the bloodstream when medically appropriate, helping address hydration needs without adding another stop to your already busy day.
Can convenience help you prioritize your wellness?
Convenience can make it easier to follow through on healthy intentions.

Think about the routines you've already established. Maybe you schedule workouts before work, prepare meals for the week, or keep a water bottle nearby. Those small decisions make healthy choices easier to maintain.
Shary believes wellness begins with everyday habits like getting enough sleep, staying hydrated, eating nutritious foods, moving your body, and making intentional choices.
Mobile IV hydration doesn't replace those foundations. Instead, it's an additional service that may fit into your wellness routine when medically appropriate.
For someone who already prioritizes their health but has limited time for appointments, having a nurse come directly to them removes a significant scheduling obstacle.
Your schedule is full. Your wellness still matters.
You don't have to completely overhaul your life to make room for healthier habits.
Sometimes it's as simple as drinking more water, getting outside in the morning, making sleep a priority, or finding services that work with your schedule rather than against it.

Whether you're running a business, raising a family, working long shifts, or traveling through Southwest Florida, Avida Luna Wellness makes it easier to access personalized IV hydration services at a location that works for you.
Life is hard. Wellness doesn't have to be.
Ready to see whether mobile IV hydration is right for you? Contact Avida Luna Wellness to discuss your options and schedule an appointment in Sarasota or Bradenton.
Frequently asked questions about mobile IV hydration
Can I receive mobile IV hydration while I'm working?

Yes. Mobile IV hydration can be administered in suitable office environments. Depending on your IV, you may be able to continue working while receiving your infusion, provided you remain available for monitoring.
Do I need to be sick to receive IV hydration?

No. However, IV hydration should be based on your individual health needs and medical eligibility. It's not routinely necessary for healthy people who are adequately hydrated, but it helps fill the gaps in nutrition that can be caused by busy schedules and drinking water alone.
Can mobile IV hydration come to my hotel or Airbnb?
Yes. Avida Luna Wellness provides mobile IV hydration at hotels, Airbnbs, and vacation rentals in its service area, subject to scheduling and location suitability.
How long does a mobile IV hydration appointment take?

Unless medically necessary to do otherwise, all infusions use an IV bag that typically takes 30–45 minutes to complete. This makes it easy to fit an appointment into your busy schedule without setting aside your entire day.
Where is mobile IV hydration available?
Avida Luna Wellness offers mobile IV hydration throughout the Sarasota and Bradenton areas, including homes, offices, hotels, and other suitable locations.

title: Understanding IV Therapy: How Intravenous Nutrients Support Hydration and Wellness
summary: A plain-language look at what a mobile IV visit is and what to expect.

children.text: Intravenous (IV) therapy has been used in clinical medicine for decades to support hydration, nutrient repletion, and recovery when oral intake is insufficient or absorption is compromised. By delivering fluids and essential nutrients directly into the bloodstream, IV therapy bypasses the digestive system, allowing for rapid and efficient availability at the cellular level.

A mobile IV visit brings nursing care to your location. Booking starts with your name and email on this website. Service selection, scheduling and confidential health screening happen on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page. Before an IV begins, Shary reviews your screening with you and checks that the service is a good fit. She stays with you throughout the visit.

question: What is mobile IV therapy?
answer: Mobile IV therapy means a registered nurse comes to you and gives your IV drip at your home, office or event, instead of you visiting a clinic or IV lounge. With Avida Luna, that nurse is always Shary Gonzalez, RN, BSN. She reviews your health screening, assesses you in person, places your IV and stays with you until it's done.

question: What services do you offer?
answer: Mobile IV drips (Hydration IV (Lactated Ringer's), Energy IV, Athlete Recovery IV, Detox/Hangover IV, Migraine IV, Myers IV and Myers with Chromium IV), IM injections (B12, B-Complex and Glutathione), IV nutrient add-ons, wellness packages, and group and corporate IV events. Restorative services (targeted red light, compression boots and aromatherapy) can be booked on their own or added to an appointment, and our Vitamin Wellness Spray is available to take home.

question: How much does mobile IV therapy cost?
answer: Hydration IV (Lactated Ringer's) is $99. Energy IV and Athlete Recovery IV are $180, Detox/Hangover IV and Migraine IV are $190, Myers IV is $199 and Myers with Chromium IV is $240. IM injections are $40 to $50, and IV nutrient add-ons are $35 to $45. Restorative services start at $20, and packages start at $45. Each booking is a one-time visit: no memberships, subscriptions or prepaid series.

question: ¿Hablas español?
answer: Sí. Shary habla inglés y español. Puedes llamarnos o escribirnos en español.

question: How do I book?
answer: For an IV, tap Book and share your name and email. You'll get your booking link right away, then pick your services, a time, and complete your screening and payment on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page. Once Shary reviews your screening, you'll be asked to get cleared by our medical provider before your visit. Optional enhancements come after. For red light, compression boots or aromatherapy on their own, book a restorative visit on this website: choose your package or service and a date and time, and Shary confirms your time by text or email.

question: How do I pay?
answer: IVs and IM injections are booked and paid on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page. For a restorative-only visit, our booking page shows your total, including the travel fee, and how you pay before you book. Enhancements and the Vitamin Wellness Spray added to an IV visit are paid at your visit, by tap to pay or card, or online on our Add-ons page. For a package that includes an IV, you pay the IV's price on the booking page and the rest of the package price at your visit.

question: Can I add red light, compression boots or aromatherapy?
answer: Yes. Added to an appointment you've already booked, they're enhancement prices: targeted red light (15 minutes) $25, compression boots (30 minutes) $35, aromatherapy $15, and the take-home Vitamin Wellness Spray $35. Booked on their own they're $29, $39 and $20, and the spray is $37. Aromatherapy — duration is based on your selected service and continues throughout that service. Enhancements are paid at your visit or online on our Add-ons page.

question: Do you offer packages or memberships?
answer: We offer wellness packages that combine services in one visit, such as Hydrate & Unwind or Luna Signature Reset. Every package is a one-time booking: there are no memberships, recurring billing or prepaid multi-visit series. Packages with an IV or IM injection include the required medical consultation at no extra charge.

question: What's your cancellation and refund policy?
answer: Our full cancellation and refund policy will be posted here. Your date and time for a restorative visit are a request until Shary confirms them by text or email. If you paid online and she can't make that time, and no other time works for you, you'll get a full refund.

question: How does an in-home IV visit work?
answer: Three steps: request an appointment (share your name and email, then choose a service and time on our secure booking page), complete a health screening and assessment, and Shary comes to your home, office or event.

question: What happens before my appointment?
answer: Every appointment includes a confidential health screening on our secure, HIPAA-compliant booking page, and Shary reviews it before your IV begins. Your health information stays there, never on this website.

question: What happens during my appointment?
answer: Shary arrives at your location, reviews your screening with you, and checks your vital signs. She then places your IV and stays with you while it runs. Most of the visit is simply time to sit back and rest.

question: How long does a visit take?
answer: An IV infusion takes about 35–40 minutes. The full appointment takes longer, because it includes your consultation, setup and any enhancements, which are done separately. Targeted red light is 15 minutes and compression boots are 30 minutes. Aromatherapy — duration is based on your selected service and continues throughout that service, so it adds no appointment time.

question: Who comes to my appointment?
answer: Shary, a registered nurse, comes to your appointment herself.

question: Is IV therapy right for me?
answer: Not everyone is a good fit for IV therapy, and that's why every appointment starts with a health screening. If anything in your screening or at your visit suggests an IV isn't right for you, Shary will tell you and suggest you speak with your doctor.

question: Who places my IV, and how is safety handled?
answer: Shary, a registered nurse with more than 17 years of nursing experience, places and monitors every IV herself. She uses sterile, single-use supplies and stays with you for the whole visit.

question: Do you come to Sarasota and Bradenton? Is there a travel fee?
answer: Shary is based in Lakewood Ranch and comes to homes, offices and events in Lakewood Ranch, Sarasota, Bradenton and nearby communities, including Siesta Key, Longboat Key, Palmer Ranch, University Park, Fruitville, Osprey and Bee Ridge. For IV appointments, including those with restorative enhancements, travel is included within a 35-minute one-way drive from her service starting location. Additional travel charges may apply and will be confirmed before booking. Restorative-only appointments have an $8 travel fee, once per appointment.

question: Do you offer group IV therapy or IV parties?
answer: Yes. Shary coordinates mobile IV hydration for workplaces, bachelorette and bridal parties, private celebrations and community events. Each guest is screened individually. Tell us about your event on our Group & corporate page.

question: Which IV drip should I choose?
answer: Hydration IV (Lactated Ringer's) is our essential IV: fluids and electrolytes. Athlete Recovery IV adds amino acids and B12 for training days, Energy IV is a blend of amino acids, vitamins and minerals for busy weeks, and Myers IV is the classic Myers cocktail. Not sure? Shary talks it through with you after your screening.

question: What's in a Myers cocktail IV?
answer: The classic Myers cocktail blend of B vitamins, vitamin C, magnesium and calcium, given with IV fluids. Myers IV is $199, and Myers with Chromium IV is $240.

question: Can I get IV therapy at home?
answer: Yes. Every Avida Luna service is mobile. Shary brings everything needed for your IV to your home, office or event in Lakewood Ranch, Sarasota, Bradenton and nearby communities, so there's no clinic or IV lounge to visit.

question: Can I get a B12 shot without an IV?
answer: B12 IM Injection ($40), B-Complex IM Injection ($45) and Glutathione IM Injection ($50) are on our menu. Booking for injection-only appointments opens soon. Every injection starts with a health screening.

question: Can I add vitamins to my IV drip?
answer: Yes. You can add B12 IV Add-On ($35), B-Complex IV Add-On ($40) or Glutathione IV Add-On ($45) to any IV. They're added to your IV, not given as separate shots. Your nurse may suggest other add-ins based on your assessment.

question: Do I need a health screening for services?
answer:
Yes. To keep you safe, medical consultations are required for our treatments:
* IVs & Injections: A telehealth medical consultation is conducted with a medical provider every 6 months.
* Peptide Support: Peptide protocols have separate consultation guidelines. Please check in with Shary to discuss your specific protocol details.
